basis:
Independent arithmetic: 32 + 0.04 × 70 = 34.8. Threshold 30 or above maps to extreme. 300 × 1.10 = 330 s/km; 300 × 1.12 = 336 s/km, both exact whole seconds.

Steps: ["Heat score = 32 + 0.04 × 70 = 34.8, rounded to one decimal.", "34.8 is at or above 30, so the band is extreme.", "The extreme band adds 10–12%: 300 × 1.10 = 330 and 300 × 1.12 = 336 whole seconds.", "Duration is exposure context only; a 120-minute session leans to the upper end and extra caution."]
Notes: An extreme band is not permission to train slowly: the safer action is to postpone, shorten or move indoors. Heat-illness symptoms require stopping; confusion, slurred speech, very high temperature or loss of consciousness is an emergency.
